text.content:
One of the most lethal swords of 2045–2050. Whereabouts unknown.

Role: Solo
Affiliation: The crew that ended Static Night
Where to find them: Nowhere. Her calls come from a different country every time
Status: Retired from the headband; edits Solo of Fortune 2070
Known for: Holding the #1 headband for two years after 2047

In 2047 Fury was a young solo with a sword and a reputation she hadn't earned yet. On Static Night she led the crew that crossed the blacked-out city for forty-eight hours to Ziggurat HQ and ended the RABIDs' attack. Afterward she held the #1 headband for two years, then walked away from it and disappeared. She won't say what happened inside Ziggurat. "Next question."

She answered Sable's request from the dark: she edits Solo of Fortune 2070, wrote the stealth and combat chapters of Sable's rulebook, and walked Lyle Thompson through Watson and Pacifica in armor she made him wear. Of the Purge itself she says: the city's still here, so it was worth it; the Purge part wasn't theirs, but other people used the dark.

GM secrets

Before the sword, Fury started out in the Combat Zone with a baseball bat. In late 2045 she was part of the crew of unknowns, on their first job, that walked Minako Arasaka home after she was kidnapped. Lyle Thompson worked it out after twenty years; asked, Fury said "Next question", which he takes as a yes.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.00, 02, 05, 08, 12
